title: Unshell's Totem of Undying
description: It's actually self explenatory; This is a Minecraft totem based of my minecraft skin.
body:
It's actually self explenatory. This is a minecraft totem based of my minecraft skin

Compatable Versions: 1.21.8, 1.21.7, 1.21.6(model gaps)

Compatable Resource Packs: Most of Them

Compatable Mods: Fabric mods, QuiltMC mods, NeoForge mods and Rift(25% done) mods.

WARNING! THIS COULD BREAK YOUR GAME IF YOU HAVE OVER 150 MODS
